{{small|(Managing Director)}} | industry = Jewellery | products = Gold, Diamond Jewellery and silver articles | revenue = {{INRConvert|650|c}} (2024) | website = {{URL|http://www.pcjeweller.com/}} }} '''PC Jeweller Limited''' is a jeweller based in [[New Delhi]], India. It started operations in April 2005 with one showroom at [[Karol Bagh]] [[Delhi]] and 50 showrooms in India.{{Cite news|title=PC Jeweller Ltd.|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/pc-jeweller-33583/information/company-history|access-date=2020-05-26}} It is a first generation business promoted by two brothers- Padam Chand Gupta and Balram Garg.{{cite web|url=http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=141113258 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130628201401/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=141113258 |archive-date=28 June 2013 |title=Company Overview of PC Jeweller Limited |publisher=Bloomberg Businessweek.com}} It presently has 50 stores in 38 cities across 13 States/UT.{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/pc-jeweller-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-42269.cms |title=PC Jeweller Ltd. |publisher=Indiatimes.com}} PC Jeweller engages in the manufacture, export, wholesale and retail of [[gold]] and [[diamond]] [[jewelry]] in India. The company's business model consists of opening large format, standalone stores at [[high street]] locations. The company sells only hall marked jewellery and certified [[diamond]] [[jewellery]].{{cn|date=January 2023|reason=This website does not exist: }} ==History== {{moresources|section|date=January 2023}} [[File:Varanasi 680a - PC Jeweller house (33653817450).jpg|thumb|A store in [[Varanasi]].]] In 2005, P Chand Jewellers was incorporated and a showroom opened in [[Karol Bagh|Karol bag]]h. In 2007, Jeweller opened two more showrooms in [[Noida]] and Panchukla (Haryana). Company also commences export operations from the manufacturing unit at the Noida SEZ. In 2008, company opened two showrooms in [[Faridabad]] and [[Dehradun]]. In 2009, company commences operations at the manufacturing unit in Selaqui,{{Cite web |last=Purohit |date=2023-12-17 |title=Home |url=https://www.capuk.in/ |access-date=2025-10-27 |website=Center for Aromatic Plants |language=en-gb}} an industrial area in Dehradun District. Company opened two showrooms in [[Pitampura]] (New Delhi) and [[Chandigarh]]. In 2011, the company changed its status from a private limited to a public limited company and was listed{{Cite web |title=NSE Stock Details |url=https://www.nseindia.com/get-quotes/equity?symbol=PCJEWELLER |website=NSE India}} on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] on 27 December 2012. Export operations unit begin from the Noida SEZ. Company opened eight showrooms in [[Ludhiana]], [[Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh|Bilaspur]], [[Pali, Rajasthan|Pali]], South Extension (New Delhi), [[Beawar]], [[Ajmer]] and [[Amritsar]]. In 2012, Jeweller opened six showrooms in [[Kanpur]], [[Rohtak]], [[Indirapuram]] (Ghaziabad), [[Rajouri Garden]] (New Delhi), [[Kingsway Camp]] (New Delhi) and Greater Kailash – 1 (New Delhi) ==Awards== {{more citations needed|section|date=February 2019}} *'''2006:''' Awarded the Best Showroom award for Diamond Season by the B2C consultants, and brand architects *'''2008:''' Awarded Jeweller of the year in the Business Sphere Awards by the Business Sphere Group, Academics Bureau Publications Private Limited. *'''2010:''' Awarded Highest Exporter and the Best Exporter in the [[Gemstone|gems]] and jewellery sector by the Noida SEZ, Department of commerce, Ministry of commerce and industry, Government of India for the year 2009-2010 *'''2011:''' Awarded Highest Exporter (SEZ Unit) and the Best Exporter (Gems and Jewellery) sector by the Noida SEZ, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India for the year 2010–2011.{{Cite web|title=History of PC Jeweller Ltd., Company|url=https://www.goodreturns.in/company/pc-jeweller/history.html#1589481000|website=Goodreturn|language=en|access-date=2020-05-15}} *'''2012:''' Awarded Niryat Shree Silver Trophy in the gems and jewellery non-MSME category, by the federation of Indian Export Organisations, set up by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India for the year 2009–2010. *'''2013:''' Awarded the Large - Plain Precious Metal Jewellery' Award at Indian Gems and Jewellery Awards{{Cite web|title=PC Jeweller bags an award at Indian Gems and Jewellery Awards|url=https://www.indianjeweller.in/Indian-Jewellery-News/4325/PC-Jeweller-bags-an-award-at-Indian-Gems-and-Jewellery-Awards|website=www.indianjeweller.in|access-date=2020-05-15}} ==Stores== PC Jeweller has 50 stores in 38 cities across 13 States/UT. The company procures a large portion of its gold under the [[Reserve Bank of India]]'s Metal (Gold) Loan policy.{{cite web|url=http://www.diamonds.net/News/NewsItem.aspx?ArticleID=42293&ArticleTitle=PC+Jeweller+to+Increase+Focus+on+Diamond+Jewelry |title=PC Jeweller to Increase Focus on Diamond Jewelry |publisher=diamonds.net|date=8 February 2013}} PC Jeweller had its [[initial public offering]] in December 2012. As of 2012 the company planned to open 20 stores each year and start opening franchise stores as well.{{cite web|url=http://www.chittorgarh.com/ipo/ipo_review.asp?a=102 |title=K.M. Global Financial Services Ltd says 'Subscribe' to PC Jeweller Ltd IPO |publisher=chittorgarh.com|date=11 December 2012}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.pcjeweller.com/ PC Jeweller Official Website] [[Category:Companies based in New Delhi]] [[Category:Jewellery retailers of India]] [[Category:Indian jewellers]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 2005]] [[Category:2005 establishments in Delhi]] [[Category:Retail companies established in 2005]] [[Category:Luxury brands]] [[Category:Diamond dealers]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract:
PC Jeweller Limited is a jeweller based in New Delhi, India. It started operations in April 2005 with one showroom at Karol Bagh Delhi and 50 showrooms in India. It is a first generation business promoted by two brothers- Padam Chand Gupta and Balram Garg. It presently has 50 stores in 38 cities across 13 States/UT.
PC Jeweller engages in the manufacture, export, wholesale and retail of gold and diamond jewelry in India. The company's business model consists of opening large format, standalone stores at high street locations. The company sells only hall marked jewellery and certified diamond jewellery.
